allow: PowerShell(Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where-Object { $_.InterfaceAlias -notmatch 'Loopback' -and $_.IPAddress -notmatch '^169' } | Select-Object InterfaceAlias, IPAddress | Format-Table -AutoSize)

PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object OwningProcess | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host "Cleared port 3000")
PowerShell(netsh advfirewall firewall show rule name="kape.dev Node Server" 2>$null)
PowerShell(netsh advfirewall firewall show rule name="Node.js" 2>$null)
PowerShell(New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName "kape.dev Store \(Port 3000\)" -Direction Inbound -Protocol TCP -LocalPort 3000 -Action Allow -Profile Any)
